name: uni-mcp
description: Out-of-the-box course assistant for university students using Canvas / Ed / Gradescope, built around the canvas-ed-mcp server. Ships the course-playbook knowledge layer (tool routing, pitfall heuristics, USYD browser routes), a guided canvas-ed-mcp server install with keychain-stored credentials, and a one-command setup that maps the user's courses and lays out a course workspace. Canvas support currently targets the University of Sydney.
